subject.title: [Bug]: WHAM probe with expired access token puts refreshable OpenAI profile into false 12h cooldown

question: Should auth-provider ownership approve the narrow WHAM guard that skips probing locally expired OpenAI OAuth access tokens and keeps the 12-hour WHAM 401 cooldown only for locally valid tokens?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the issue is protected and the fix changes how OpenAI OAuth credential-health evidence drives provider cooldown state.

options.title: Approve the narrow expiry guard
options.body: Implement the guard with focused tests for expired-token skip behavior and locally-valid-token 401 behavior.

options.title: Refresh before probing
options.body: Require the WHAM path to refresh OAuth credentials before probing, accepting a broader auth-flow change and more provider interaction.

options.title: Hold for live provider proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a maintainer captures redacted live WHAM behavior for expired and locally valid access tokens.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow expiry guard
recommendation.body: Implement the guard with focused tests for expired-token skip behavior and locally-valid-token 401 behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-line and recent auth-profile usage history signal for the affected WHAM cooldown surface.
